slices.focus: Company adopts Jae-hyun's full dispatch reliability package as procedure.
slices.summary: The company formally adopts the complete reliability package (common board layout, signed turnover format, severe-weather hold sheet, official digital template) as the standing procedure for short-haul dispatch. Jae-hyun feels deep relief but also unexpected exhaustion. He plans a short note upward about the system's structural value, a three-point monitoring check (signature gaps, weather coding, board-digital alignment), and a quiet evening at home to acknowledge the milestone.
open_loops: Transition from policer to maintainer of an official system
Requesting formal support (training time, audit capacity)
Allowing system to prove itself without hypervigilance
